title: Bug: `crm/test_crm.py` fails with `[Errno 7] Argument list too long: '/bin/sh` when neighbor add command is too long
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Failure:
```
  File "/data/tests/crm/test_crm.py", line 793, in test_crm_neighbor
    configure_neighbors(amount=neighbours_num, interface=crm_interface[0], ip_ver=ip_ver,
  File "/data/tests/crm/test_crm.py", line 423, in configure_neighbors
    asichost.shell(add_neighbors_template.render(
  File "/data/tests/common/devices/sonic_asic.py", line 580, in shell
    return self.sonichost.shell(*module_args, **complex_args)
  File "/data/tests/common/devices/base.py", line 131, in _run
    raise RunAnsibleModuleFail("run module {} failed".format(self.module_name), res)
tests.common.errors.RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module shell failed, Ansible Results =>
failed = True
rc = 7
cmd = for s in 2.0.0.1 2.0.0.2 <snip>  2.0.126.78 2.0.126.79 do ip neigh replace '${s}' lladdr 11:22:33:44:55:66 dev PortChannel2001 echo added - '${s}' done
msg = [Errno 7] Argument list too long: '/bin/sh
```


In `crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_neighbor` the test tries to add 1% of the available IPv4 neighbors.
On systems with very large number of neighbors:
```
> sonic-db-cli  COUNTERS_DB HMGET CRM:STATS crm_stats_ipv4_neighbor_used crm_stats_ipv4_neighbor_available
5
3233468
```
Just 1% of this is `((5 + 3233468) // 100) + 1 = 32335` neighbors.

This results in a very long command in the form of:
```
for s in 2.0.0.1 2.0.0.2 <snip> 2.0.126.78 2.0.126.79 do ip neigh replace '${s}' lladdr 11:22:33:44:55:66 dev PortChannel2001
```

Because there is a 128KB character limit in the command this ends up going beyond our limit:
```
(Pdb) len(ip_addr_list)
345913
```

Hence the error:
```
msg = [Errno 7] Argument list too long: '/bin/sh
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `crm/test_crm.py::test_crm_neighbor` on a device that supports a large number of IPv4 neighbors (> 900000)

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test shouldn't fail because of a character limit issue due to our command length.

linkedPullRequests.title: Batch neighbor add/del commands in `test_crm_neighbor`
linkedPullRequests.author: arista-nwolfe
linkedPullRequests.body:
On certain platforms `test_crm_neighbor` can create commands that go beyond our character limit, resulting in errors like:
`[Errno 7] Argument list too long: '/bin/sh`

This change will chunk up the long commands into smaller batches that don't go beyond the character limit to avoid hitting these failures.

Details in: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/18624

A similar issue and solution has been seen in this test in the past, used the same approach:
Issue: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/8125
Solution: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/8126

Summary:
Fixes #18624

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: The change logic looks good to me. One minor suggestion, why not put the commands into a bash script and run the script instead of running it in batches? If there are too many ip addr in the list, that can result in multiple SSH and multiple calls.

comments.author: arista-nwolfe
comments.body:
> The change logic looks good to me. One minor suggestion, why not put the commands into a bash script and run the script instead of running it in batches? If there are too many ip addr in the list, that can result in multiple SSH and multiple calls.

Is your suggestion to create a file with the batched up commands on the duthost first and then make one call to `shell` to execute that file? I figured this would be overkill as more than likely this will only execute the `shell` command 1-4 times.

Also there is already a precedent of doing it this way here: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/8126

Update: I checked the timestamps of the calls in the test, all the time is spent in orchagent updating the routes, so I don't think removing the multiple shell calls will save us much time:

Test triggers first batch
```
28/05/2025 17:31:44 base._run                                L0071 DEBUG  | /data/tests/common/devices/sonic_asic.py::shell#580: [qzq203] AnsibleModule::shell, args=["\n    \n    \n    \n    \n    for s in 2.0.0.1 <snip>
```

Duthost receives ansible request and spends time processing neighbors:
```
2025 May 28 17:31:44.218468 qzq203 INFO python[20541]: ansible-ansible.legacy.command Invoked with _raw_params=#012    #012    #012    #012    #012    for s in 2.0.0.1 <snip>
2025 May 28 17:31:44.225972 qzq203 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addNeighbor: Created neighbor ip 2.0.0.1, 11:22:33:44:55:66 on PortChannel2001
2025 May 28 17:31:44.226678 qzq203 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addNextHop: Created next hop 2.0.0.1 on PortChannel2001
<snip>
2025 May 28 17:32:01.416682 qzq203 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addNeighbor: Created neighbor ip 2.0.35.40, 11:22:33:44:55:66 on PortChannel2001
2025 May 28 17:32:01.417084 qzq203 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- addNextHop: Created next hop 2.0.35.40 on PortChannel2001
```

Test triggers next batch:
```
28/05/2025 17:32:01 base._run                                L0071 DEBUG  | /data/tests/common/devices/sonic_asic.py::shell#580: [qzq203] AnsibleModule::shell, args=["\n    \n    \n    \n    \n    for s in 2.0.35.41 <snip>
```
